{{Quote|But how can Anakin be a pilot? He's just a slave.<br/> In this life, you can do lots of things, how you end up is on you.|Seek and a spacer on Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Anakin'sFate">''[[Anakin's Fate]]''</ref>}}
'''Seek''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-headed [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the slave quarters of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. As a child, he knew [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] before the boy left to train as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Seek was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TPM" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the local bully of the [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the<ref name="Melee" /> [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="MosEspa">{{DB|location|mosespa|Mos Espa}}</ref> [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="Melee" /> He was a friend of the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Like Skywalker's other friend, [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]], Seek wanted to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and leave Tatooine, never to come back.<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> He also befriended the young slave girl, [[Melee/Legends|Melee]]. The ill-tempered duo of Melee and Seek would often tease the children who dared to dream of a better life beyond Mos Espa,<ref name="Melee" /> even though he had his own dream.<ref name="Journal" />

During an [[Local day/Legends|evening]]<ref name="Anakin'sFate" /> some point prior to or during [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="FateDate">''[[Anakin's Fate]]'' is set before {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]</ref> Seek and Banai sneaked into a junkyard in Mos Espa after Skywalker lost a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] to the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. Skywalker's [[enslaver]], [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], ordered him to fix to damaged [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] until dark, though the pair called out for him. One of them congratulated Skywalker before a nervous Seek asked Skywalker if Watto was around, though he was assured he was not by Skywalker. Banai suggested they get drinks, and the trio drank [[Ruby bliel|ruby bliels]] and listened in on pilots talking about their adventures. A [[Unidentified retired Galactic Republic pilot|space pilot]] complemented Skywalker's performance in the race. The pilot added that when he was a kid, that he could not drive a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] as a kid, but still dreamed of being a pilot. Skywalker asked if he could become a pilot, and the man assured him that if he could fly a podracer, he could become a pilot. Seek asked the pilot how the enslaved Skywalker could become one, and the man told him that your fate was dependent on yourself.<ref name="Anakin'sFate" /> 

On the eve of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace, Seek and Melee joined Anakin's friends as young Skywalker tested his [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] in the backyard of his hovel. Melee was doubtful that the racer would ever run, and Seek, bored of Anakin's achievements, suggested him and his friends go play ball rather than help Anakin prepare. However, Seek and Melee attended the race, though Melee &ndash; harboring a secret crush on the young podracer &ndash; left Seek's side to watch Anakin's performance from the grandstands. When Anakin left Tatooine, Melee returned to Seek, though now with a more positive outlook on life than her sour friend.

==Behind the Scenes==
Seek was portrayed by [[Oliver Walpole]] in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]'' though his name isn't said, his name is revealed in the credits.<ref name="TPM" />
